scope: Single connection, deterministic complete typed physical catalog, canonical SQL statement order; no consumer SQL reparsing or speculative vendor semantics.

evidence_rules.states: Exact requires every before/after live relation bag and source occurrence, including reads, writes and restored rollback generations
evidence_rules.domain: INTEGER point domains with inclusive lower/upper and explicit SQL NULL; all output counts and exact frequencies derive from complete bags
evidence_rules.positive_negative: Track every SQL TRUE and NOT TRUE (FALSE or UNKNOWN) source ordinal; rejected rows cannot be silently omitted
evidence_rules.proof: A contradictory complete schema/write or lifecycle is Impossible, unproved engine/adapter law is Residual with explicit owner
evidence_rules.independent_engine: DuckDB snapshots must be measured from executed SQL, not copied from protocol output

adapter_matrix.sql: DuckDB native executable mixed script; canonical dialect parsing for all 13 names
adapter_matrix.dbt: Compiled model SQL and equivalent relation schemas certify matching canonical source/terminal facts, not transaction execution or inferred DDL
adapter_matrix.odcs: Equivalent typed relation schema, defaults and constraints only when contract explicitly attests them; no inferred session laws
